- Executive Summary: The Optimizely Web experimentation platform suffered a supply chain attack where attackers injected malicious code into the Project JavaScript field, affecting 178 organizations including Zoom, CNN, and HSBC. The payload enabled cryptocurrency theft, payment card skimming, data exfiltration, and the delivery of Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits via legitimate CDN scripts.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Optimizely; impacted organizations include Zoom, CNN, HSBC, Salesforce, GitLab, etc.: Attackers manipulated the Project JavaScript field to inject malicious scripts, leading to asset theft and iOS exploit delivery
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Exploitation of implicit trust in third-party CDN-served dependencies bypassing local security infrastructure
* [Key Fact Detail] Optimizely platform compromised, distributing malicious JS via legitimate CDN.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Systemic vulnerability caused by excessive trust in third-party dependencies.

### US data centers now burn more electricity than a midsized country
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/dccd3c5dab49276e

Findings highlight a critical contradiction between AI infrastructure scaling and energy sustainability, as fossil fuels remain the primary power source, contributing to 25.7 million metric tons of CO2 emissions.
- Key Verified Facts:
* [Core Event] Gianluca Guidi (Harvard University) and MIT research team (Nature Sustainability): Quantifying energy consumption and carbon footprints of U.S. hyperscale data centers
* [Root Cause & Mechanism] Evaluating the long-term impact of generative AI infrastructure scaling on global climate goals
* [Key Metrics] Fossil fuels account for approximately 54% of electricity consumption.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Regulatory conflict between compute growth and energy traceability.

- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/news/fa4809fd5f0150cc

* [Root Cause & Mechanism] To overcome theoretical bottlenecks in simulating the Standard Model on a lattice
* [Key Technical Spec] Core breakthrough: GPT-6 Astra constructed and proved a solution for the overlap fermion phase problem in lattice field theory.
* [Key Position & Outlook] Strategic outlook: AI now demonstrates elite-level rigorous proving capabilities in foundational mathematics and physics, following the Navier-Stokes milestone.

## Section 3: Flagship Technical Dissections

### Claude Code CLI & Terminal Autonomous Agent: Architecture, Shell Sandboxing & Enterprise Cost Optimization
- URL: https://ainewsradar.xyz/articles/2026-10-14-claude-code-agent-guide
